author: 980corrinas

title: Car rental Seville: Remarkable Centauro Agency
text:
Rental of a small car at the Centauro agency at Seville station (Santa Justa): vehicle reserved 1 month in advance on their site from Toulouse and without ever being asked for a credit card number.
Very professional welcome and remarkable service. Very reasonable price with comprehensive insurance. Just a deposit of 121 Euros to pay in addition to bring the car back with a full tank.
This deposit was refunded in less than 2 days after return of the vehicle as agreed.
I highly recommend this agency.

title: Coming from Australia, I...
text: Coming from Australia, I found the history of Italica amazing. Seeing actual ruins from the 2nd century is awesome . Great tour I had a wonderful time and as I am an older female  solo traveller I would recommend it to other solo travellers.
author: Dayle_R

title: Spectacular Roman Ruins a Short Ride from Seville.
text: This was a great tour.  The sites are only 20-30 minutes away fro Seville by bus. It was interesting learning about Rome’s first settlement in Spain. Carlos, the tour guide, was very knowledgeable. The Emperors Hadrian and Trajan were both born here.  The monastery was also interesting. Two little notes though. This isn’t really a Game of Thrones filming site tour. The guide mentioned quickly on our way out: “oh, by the way, the arena was the site of the dragon pit in Game of Thrones”. title: Itálica city
text:
Really enjoyable few hours spent at Italica. It’s a fascinating place and being able to get so close to the stadium and the town was amazing.
